About Saltire

Saltire Infrastructure Pty Ltd is a specialist civil contracting company focused on delivering services to Western Australia’s water service industry. We are committed to reducing carbon emissions and water consumption across our business. Our utilisation of specialised equipment and technologies, such as hot tapping, eliminates water loss incurred using traditional connection methods.

About the Role

Saltire is actively seeking experienced Drainers with experience to join our team.

Operational duties of a Drainer include:

* Establishes and maintains trenches to precise depths and gradients for laying pipes.
* Install various sizes and types of pipework, new culverts, and stormwater systems per technical specifications.
* Refilling trenches and compacting soil to ensure group stability
* Conduct CCTV camera inspections to diagnose drainage issues such as blockages and structural damage.
* Perform pressure testing and other diagnostics to identify leaks and faults.
* Operate heavy machinery including Telehandlers and Crew Trucks, as well as hand tools for excavation and pipe laying.
* Diagnosis, maintenance and repairs of piping systems.
* Locate existing underground services.
* Clear debris and excavate trenches for pipe installations.
* Ensure compliance with local, state, and federal regulations, and environmental guidelines.

Qualifications

* Experience (at least 3 years preferred) in civil construction work sites and working around live services
* Relevant experience in pipe laying
* Flexibility to work overtime, shifts, and regional assignments as required
* Strong understanding of safety regulations and confined space procedures.
* Excellent communication and teamwork skills.
* Construction White card - preferred or willingness to obtain
* Driver's licence HR (open, unrestricted) – preferred

If you feel that this role is for you, apply now! We would be delighted to have you onboard.

## Position Overview
We are looking for a detail-oriented and highly organised Program or Project Administrator to support the effective delivery of organisational programs and special projects. In this role, you will serve as a central point of coordination, ensuring administrative functions run smoothly and that project activities are tracked, documented, and communicated with precision. The ideal candidate brings strong analytical capabilities, excellent communication skills, and the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment. This is a key support role suited to a proactive professional who thrives on keeping complex initiatives on track.
## Key Responsibilities
- Provide high-level administrative support across multiple programs and projects, ensuring all activities are coordinated efficiently and align with organisational objectives
- Advise senior management on emerging matters requiring attention, prepare briefing materials, and follow through on the implementation of their decisions
- Prepare, review, and distribute submissions, reports, and correspondence relating to program and project activities, ensuring accuracy and adherence to organisational standards
- Collect, organise, and analyse data associated with ongoing projects, monitoring progress against milestones and reporting on outcomes to key stakeholders
- Oversee the work of contractors and external service providers, tracking deliverables and reporting on any variations to agreed work orders or scopes
- Maintain and update project documentation including schedules, risk registers, action logs, and status reports throughout the project lifecycle
- Coordinate meetings, workshops, and project-related events, including preparation of agendas, minute-taking, and follow-up on action items
- Liaise with internal teams, external partners, and stakeholders to facilitate clear communication and ensure project information is shared in a timely manner
- Review and coordinate arrangements for office accommodation and workspace requirements, supporting the organisation's operational and project-related needs
- Support budget administration by tracking expenditure, processing invoices, and flagging variances to project managers or senior leadership
- Assist in the development and continuous improvement of administrative systems, processes, and templates to enhance project delivery efficiency
- Ensure compliance with relevant policies, procedures, and governance frameworks across all program and project administration activities
## Required Qualifications & Skills
- A qualification in business administration, project management, or a related discipline; or equivalent professional experience in a similar role
- Demonstrated experience in a program or project administration role within a corporate, government, or professional services environment
- Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint, as well as project management or collaboration tools such as Microsoft Project, Asana, or similar platforms
- Proven ability to analyse data, produce clear and accurate reports, and present findings to varied audiences including senior management
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to draft professional correspondence, submissions, and reports to a high standard
- Highly developed organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and adapt to changing project demands
- Sound understanding of project management principles and the ability to apply them in a practical administrative context
- Ability to work both autonomously and collaboratively within cross-functional teams, demonstrating initiative and sound judgement
- Strong attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy across all documentation and reporting outputs
## Preferred Qualifications
- A CAPM, PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent project management certification, or active progress towards one
- Experience working within a PMO (Project Management Office) environment
- Familiarity with contract administration processes and managing third-party service providers
- Exposure to government or regulated industry environments where compliance and governance requirements are particularly stringent
- Experience supporting large-scale or multi-stream programs involving diverse stakeholder groups
## Why Join Us?
- Be part of a collaborative and supportive team culture where your contributions are recognised and valued
- Enjoy genuine flexibility with work arrangements designed to support work-life balance
- Access ongoing professional development opportunities, including support for further study and project management certifications
- Work on meaningful programs and projects that make a tangible impact within the organisation and the communities it serves
- Competitive remuneration package with a clear pathway for career progression into senior project or program management roles
## Job Details
- Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
- Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
- Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super
